The '''Grimwald system''' was located in the [[Truum sector/Legends|Truum sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the items known as [[Grimwaldi sponge chair]]s.<ref name="Journal7">{{JournalCite|7|Into the Core Worlds}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Grimwaldi sponge chair]]s|system=Grimwald [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Grimwald [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-8.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
